alex: quick heads-up — running the large-load replay and we see short (<=16 tok) p95 latency spike when long (>=1024 tok) requests are active. looks like queue head-of-line and kernel switching overheads.

marta: wow, numbers?

ryan: reproduced locally. short requests median ~6ms -> 18ms under mixed workload. kernel switches per second up ~1.8x. KV miss rate jumps when long seqs stream and evict microcache entries.

devon: profiler snippet from a failing run:```
time,scheduler_queue_len,short_q_len,long_q_len,kernel_switches,kv_hit_rate
00:00:10,42,30,12,190,0.78
00:00:20,58,38,20,360,0.54
00:00:30,70,45,25,520,0.41
```

perf-bot: [deploy 2026-02-21T14:05Z] Canary rollout: inference-runtime v3.4.2 started, traffic=30% :robot_face:

alex: looks like two interacting issues: 1) batch formation policy is coalescing short into long windows because of merge_window tuning, 2) kernel selection cost when switching context between long and short shapes. both increase queueing for short tails.

sasha: proposal: implement a "soft-priority" micro-lane for short requests + kernel-hint header. short lane gets micro-slab that is drained every X ms and preempts bulk lane if wait > aging_threshold. long requests yield after slice_tokens so they don't hog the device.

marta: sounds good. parameters to experiment with: `micro_slab_size`, `max_wait_ms`, `slice_tokens`, `merge_window_ms`, `kernel_hint_score`. my rough defaults: micro_slab_size=8, max_wait_ms=10, slice_tokens=128, merge_window_ms=2, kernel_hint_score=0.9

ryan: we should also try per-tenant micro-reservations: keep a tiny reserved token budget for high-SLO tenants so they don't get starved during KV warmup storms. add an eviction grace window for KV entries pinned by short requests.

devon: added an experiment harness script:```bash
# run mixed-workload local replay
./tools/replay --trace traces/mixed_short_long.json --scheduler-config experiments/soft_priority.yaml --out perf/output_soft_priority.log
```

alex: quick perf results from a short run with soft-priority + kernel_hint (50% short traffic):
```
config: soft_priority=true, slice_tokens=128, max_wait_ms=8
short_p95_before=18.2ms, short_p95_after=7.1ms
long_throughput_before=420 seq/s, long_throughput_after=405 seq/s
kv_miss_rate_before=0.48, kv_miss_rate_after=0.36
kernel_switches/s before=520, after=220
```

marta: those are promising. small throughput hit for long, big win for short tails. :thumbsup:

ryan: one caveat: kernel_hint needs to survive model variant fallback. if we route to a smaller model we should translate the hint -> compatible kernel preference. otherwise hint ignored and short gets delayed.

sasha: true. I suggest we add a kernel-compat mapping and a fallback policy: `hint_score` -> list of preferred kernels. runtime picks closest available. also log when hint is dropped.

devon: for experiment matrix:
- A: soft-priority only
- B: kernel-hint only
- C: soft-priority + kernel-hint
- D: per-tenant micro-reservations + C
measure: short_p95, short_p99, long_throughput, avg_kernel_switches/s, kv_miss_rate, fairness_index

alex: action items:
- @sasha: spike kernel-compat mapping and drop logging (EOD?)
- @devon: run A/B/C/D matrix on canary (small runs) and upload perf logs
- @marta: craft a short perf dashboard (short tails + kernel-switch metric)
- @ryan: prototype KV pinning heuristics and eviction grace window

marta: I'll add dashboard tiles and a tiny alert if short_p95 > 12ms for any tenant.

ryan: volunteer to own the fairness_index calc (Gini-like) and add it to dashboard.

alex: great. priority is to reduce short tail regressions before we expand canary. please post perf artifacts here. :eyes:
